service.method: SELECT USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.COMPANY_CODE AS SELLER_CODE , USMT.PLANT_CODE , USMT.DEPT , USMT.POSITION , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.USER_NAME_ENG , USMT.SIGN_STATUS , USMT.USER_TYPE , USMT.WORK_TYPE , USMT.EMAIL , USMT.STATE , USMT.THEME , #DB_OWNER#GETDEPTNAME(USMT.HOUSE_CODE, USMT.COMPANY_CODE, USMT.DEPT, 'KO') AS DEPT_NAME , USMT.COUNTRY , USMT.TIME_ZONE , USMT.LANGUAGE , USMT.DATE_FORMAT , USMT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , USMT.RESPONSIBILITY , BAGL.CTRL_NAME_LOC , ADDR.PHONE_NO1 , ADDR.PHONE_NO2 , ADDR.ZIP_CODE , ADDR.ADDRESS_LOC , ADDR.ADDRESS_ENG , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO -- , USMT.COSTCETNER_CODE , CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADDR ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'USER' LEFT OUTER JOIN SBAGL BAGL ON USMT.CTRL_CODE = BAGL.CTRL_CODE AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = BAGL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = BAGL.COMPANY_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE USMT.USER_ID = ${USER_ID} AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N'
UPDATE SUSMT SET CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID}, DEL_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE USER_ID = ${USER_ID} AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND USER_ID =${USER_ID}
